instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: End-to-End Dropshipping Launch 6 days left Verified Over the next 15 days I intend to put a fully-functioning Shopify dropshipping store online and drive it to a stable net profit target of about $500 per month. Every stage—from product discovery through to customer acquisition—has to be covered, because I’m starting from absolute scratch and am open to any product category that can prove itself profitable. Here is how I picture the engagement: • Product sourcing: research, supplier outreach, sample checks, and final supplier selection. • Store setup & design: build the Shopify storefront, optimise theme, load products with high-converting copy, connect payment and shipping apps. • Marketing & promotion: craft the launch strategy (Facebook/Instagram ads, email flows, influencer or UGC if it mak... human_actions: Authorize use of a truthful Freelancer.com account and review/accept the platform terms so Louis OS can submit the already prepared proposal or quote. Do not complete KYC or configure payout unless the platform explicitly requests it later.
payment_methods: Freelancer milestone payment; account payout method selected after award
rationale: hours and page volume are scoring inputs, not standalone rejection gates
headline prize size is not used as the primary ranking signal
